answers.rationale: The requirement specifies 15 kV metal-clad switchgear with specific ratings and features. The CROWN-ARMV product is designed for such applications, meeting IEEE C37.20.2 standards for metal-clad switchgear.
The requirement for rigid bus bar connections to roll-out potential transformer trays aligns with the construction and design of the CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
The detailed specifications for circuit breaker compartments, including vacuum breakers and CTs, are consistent with the features of the CROWN-ARMV product.
The requirement for operation on a solidly grounded 13.2 kV system is within the capabilities of the CROWN-ARMV switchgear, which supports such configurations.
The inclusion of gang-operated isolation switches is a feature that can be integrated into the CROWN-ARMV switchgear as part of its customizable options.
The requirement for specific metering CTs, VTs, and ground balls aligns with the CROWN-ACC product, which provides accessories for MV switchgear, including metering and grounding components.
The requirement for compliance with the latest IEEE standards for metal-clad switchgear is directly met by the CROWN-ARMV product, which adheres to IEEE C37.20.2 standards.
